notes.title: End free mode
notes.content: After a period of free-to-play purchases, we decided to change the game to a paid model after a week, and then continued to update and optimize it

notes.title: The game will be changed to free
notes.content: Due to the pitiful low sales after the game was released, and not even a single comment, since I couldn't make any money, I decided to let more people play this game. As a result, I decided to change the game to free in a week. Players who purchase in the future will not be affected, although there have been no recent purchases by players.

notes.title: Updated on June 7th
notes.content: Optimize collapse animation to make the collapse chain reaction more natural
